ex.en: The aggregate cost of the project was over budget.
ex.zh: 專案的總成本超出預算。

ex.en: Aggregate demand fell during the recession.
ex.zh: 經濟衰退期間，總需求下降了。

aggregate.en: made up of many parts added together

ex.en: The app aggregates news from many sources.
ex.zh: 這個 App 匯集了許多來源的新聞。

ex.en: We aggregated the data from all branches.
ex.zh: 我們彙整了所有分公司的資料。

aggregate.en: to collect many things into one group or total

ex.en: In aggregate, sales rose by ten percent.
ex.zh: 整體來看，銷售額成長了一成。

ex.en: Taken in aggregate, the results are encouraging.
ex.zh: 整體來看，結果令人振奮。

ex.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
ex.zh: 政府應該增加對農業的投資。

ex.en: Agriculture consumes a great amount of water.
ex.zh: 農業需要消耗大量的水。

ex.en: This land is not suitable for agriculture.
ex.zh: 這塊地不適合務農。

agriculture.en: the work of growing crops and raising animals on farms

ex.en: In my view you should try the exam again.
ex.zh: 我認為你應該再考一次。

ex.en: Our teacher warned him not to be late again.
ex.zh: 老師警告他不要再遲到。

ex.en: There is little chance of my meeting him again.
ex.zh: 我大概不會再見到他了。

ex.en: When I was your age, Pluto was a planet.
ex.zh: 我在你這個年紀時，冥王星還是行星。

ex.en: The difference in their ages is six years.
ex.zh: 他們相差六歲。

ex.en: Because of his age, my grandfather doesn't hear well.
ex.zh: 因為年紀大了，我祖父聽力不太好。

age.en: the number of years a person has lived

ex.en: My father aged a lot since last year.
ex.zh: 我爸從去年到現在老了很多。

ex.en: An aging population will require more spending on health care.
ex.zh: 人口老化將需要更多醫療保健支出。

ex.en: We live in the digital age.
ex.zh: 我們生活在數位時代。

ex.en: The internet age has changed how we work.
ex.zh: 網路時代改變了我們的工作方式。

ex.en: You should have told me a long time ago.
ex.zh: 你早就該告訴我了。

ex.en: She finished ironing the clothes a few minutes ago.
ex.zh: 她幾分鐘前燙完了衣服。

ex.en: Prices are double what they were ten years ago.
ex.zh: 物價是十年前的兩倍。

ago.en: back in the past from now

agency.zh: 代理商、仲介公司（travel agency 旅行社）

ex.en: Travel agencies' profits soared.
ex.zh: 旅行社的利潤大幅成長。

ex.en: He works for an advertising agency.
ex.zh: 他在一家廣告公司工作。

ex.en: The car rental agency provided excellent customer service.
ex.zh: 這家租車公司提供了很棒的客戶服務。

agency.en: a business that arranges services for other people

ex.en: The government agency approved the new drug.
ex.zh: 政府機構核准了這種新藥。

ex.en: She works for an environmental agency.
ex.zh: 她在一個環保機構工作。

agency.en: a government office that does a particular job

ex.en: Get in touch with your agent right away.
ex.zh: 立刻聯絡你的經紀人。

ex.en: I'm not signing anything until I speak with my agent.
ex.zh: 在跟我的經紀人談過之前，我什麼都不會簽。

ex.en: In case of an emergency, get in touch with my agent.
ex.zh: 萬一有緊急情況，請聯絡我的代理人。

agent.en: a person who acts for another person in business matters

agent.zh: 服務人員、業務員（travel agent 旅行社人員）

ex.en: A travel agent will arrange an excursion to Andalusia for you.
ex.zh: 旅行社人員會幫你安排去安達魯西亞的旅遊。

ex.en: Sami was a customer service agent.
ex.zh: 薩米是一名客服人員。

agent.en: a person who arranges services or sells things for a company

ex.en: Portugal was once an agricultural country.
ex.zh: 葡萄牙曾經是一個農業國家。

ex.en: On the border, there is a stretch of agricultural land.
ex.zh: 邊境上有一片農地。

ex.en: Agricultural products are a major export of the country.
ex.zh: 農產品是這個國家主要的出口品。

ex.en: He is an aggressive person.
ex.zh: 他是個咄咄逼人的人。

ex.en: The dog becomes aggressive when strangers come close.
ex.zh: 陌生人靠近時，這隻狗會變得很兇。

aggressive.en: ready to fight or attack others

ex.en: You need to be aggressive.
ex.zh: 你需要更積極一點。

ex.en: The company has an aggressive marketing strategy.
ex.zh: 這家公司的行銷策略非常積極。

aggressive.en: very determined and eager to win or succeed

ex.en: He agrees with my opinion.
ex.zh: 他同意我的意見。

ex.en: I agree with what you say to some extent.
ex.zh: 在某種程度上，我認同你所說的。

ex.en: Oh, I don't know if I agree with you.
ex.zh: 嗯，我不確定我同不同意你的看法。

agree.en: to have the same opinion as someone

ex.en: Thank you for agreeing to meet with us.
ex.zh: 謝謝你答應跟我們見面。

ex.en: We agreed to start early the next morning.
ex.zh: 我們說好隔天一早出發。

ex.en: I'm surprised you agreed to have lunch with me.
ex.zh: 我很意外你願意跟我吃午餐。

agree.en: to say yes to a plan or a request

ex.en: They still attacked us, despite clearly agreeing to sign the non-aggression pact.
ex.zh: 明明簽訂了互不侵犯條約，竟然還來攻擊我們。

ex.en: As North Korea displays aggression, South Korea concentrates its forces near the border.
ex.zh: 韓國隨著朝鮮的外患而在邊界附近集結軍隊。

aggression.en: angry or violent behavior toward another person or country

ex.en: Some dogs show aggression toward strangers.
ex.zh: 有些狗對陌生人表現出攻擊性。

ex.en: The coach told the players to channel their aggression into the game.
ex.zh: 教練要球員把他們的攻擊性轉化到比賽中。

aggression.en: a tendency to be angry and ready to fight

ex.en: He cried out in agony when the doctor touched his leg.
ex.zh: 醫生一碰到他的腿，他就痛得大叫。

ex.en: The family waited in agony for news of the missing boy.
ex.zh: 全家人痛苦地等待著失蹤男孩的消息。

agony.en: very strong pain in the body or mind

ex.en: The app shows an aggregation of news from many different websites.
ex.zh: 這個應用程式彙整了許多不同網站的新聞。

ex.en: The aggregation of data from all branches took a whole week.
ex.zh: 彙整所有分店的資料花了整整一個星期。

aggregation.en: a group of things gathered together

ex.en: We have reached a partnership agreement.
ex.zh: 我們簽訂了合作協議。

ex.en: There needs to be agreement between European countries.
ex.zh: 歐洲各國之間需要達成協議。

ex.en: We have to come to some agreement.
ex.zh: 我們必須達成某種協議。

agreement.en: a formal arrangement that people have made together

ex.en: I'm not in agreement with your methods at all.
ex.zh: 我完全不贊同你的做法。

ex.en: There is not one person who is in agreement with the plan.
ex.zh: 沒有一個人贊成這個計畫。

agreement.en: the state of having the same opinion

ex.en: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
ex.zh: 我們繼續討論議程上的項目吧。

ex.en: What's on the agenda for today's meeting?
ex.zh: 今天會議的議程有哪些？

agenda.en: a list of things to talk about at a meeting

ex.en: The aged man walked slowly with a cane.
ex.zh: 年邁的老人拄著拐杖慢慢走。

ex.en: She takes care of her aged parents.
ex.zh: 她照顧年邁的父母。

ex.en: They have a son aged five.
ex.zh: 他們有一個五歲的兒子。

ex.en: The survey included people aged between 20 and 30.
ex.zh: 這項調查包含年齡介於二十到三十歲的人。

against.zh: 反對、違反（against the law 違法）

ex.en: Parking here is against the law.
ex.zh: 在這裡停車是違法的。

ex.en: Many people voted against the new plan.
ex.zh: 很多人投票反對這個新計畫。

ex.en: Our school played against a team from Taichung.
ex.zh: 我們學校和一支台中的隊伍比賽。

ex.en: The two countries fought against a common enemy.
ex.zh: 兩國共同對抗同一個敵人。

against.zh: 靠著、貼著（lean against the wall）

ex.en: He leaned against the wall to rest.
ex.zh: 他靠著牆休息。

ex.en: Rain beat against the window all night.
ex.zh: 雨整晚拍打著窗戶。

ex.en: Regular exercise can slow down the aging process.
ex.zh: 規律運動可以減緩老化的過程。

ex.en: The study looks at how aging affects memory.
ex.zh: 這項研究探討老化如何影響記憶力。

ex.en: Japan has an aging population.
ex.zh: 日本的人口正在高齡化。

ex.en: The aging bridge needs to be repaired soon.
ex.zh: 這座老舊的橋很快就需要修繕。

agreed.zh: 同意；達成共識（agree 的過去式）

ex.en: After a long talk, they agreed on a price.
ex.zh: 經過長談，他們談妥了價錢。

ex.en: She agreed to help me move next weekend.
ex.zh: 她答應下週末幫我搬家。

ex.en: We met at the agreed time in front of the station.
ex.zh: 我們在約定的時間於車站前碰面。

ex.en: Both sides paid the agreed amount on the first day.
ex.zh: 雙方在第一天就付了說好的金額。

ex.en: Regular exercise can slow down the ageing process.
ex.zh: 規律運動可以減緩老化的過程。

ex.en: Ageing is a natural part of life that happens to everyone.
ex.zh: 變老是人生中自然的一部分，每個人都會經歷。

ex.en: The ageing of the population is a challenge for many countries.
ex.zh: 人口老化是許多國家面臨的挑戰。

ex.en: The company is aggressively expanding into new markets.
ex.zh: 這家公司正積極擴展到新的市場。

ex.en: She aggressively pursued her goal of becoming a doctor.
ex.zh: 她積極追求成為醫生的目標。

aggressively.zh: 咄咄逼人地；有攻擊性地

ex.en: The dog barked aggressively at the stranger.
ex.zh: 那隻狗對陌生人凶猛地吠叫。

ex.en: He spoke aggressively and made everyone uncomfortable.
ex.zh: 他說話咄咄逼人，讓大家都很不自在。

ex.en: He paced the room in agitation while waiting for the news.
ex.zh: 他等消息時焦躁不安地在房裡踱步。

ex.en: Her voice shook with agitation.
ex.zh: 她的聲音因激動而顫抖。

ex.en: The agitation of the water made the powder dissolve quickly.
ex.zh: 攪動水使粉末很快溶解。

ex.en: Gentle agitation helps the liquid mix evenly.
ex.zh: 輕輕攪動能讓液體均勻混合。

ex.en: Scratching the rash will only aggravate it.
ex.zh: 抓皮疹只會讓它更嚴重。

ex.en: His rude answer aggravated the situation.
ex.zh: 他無禮的回答使情況更加惡化。

ex.en: We spent an agreeable afternoon in the garden.
ex.zh: 我們在花園裡度過了一個愉快的下午。

ex.en: He is an agreeable person who gets along with everyone.
ex.zh: 他是個隨和的人，跟誰都處得來。

ex.en: If you are agreeable, we can start on Monday.
ex.zh: 如果你同意，我們可以星期一開始。

ex.en: She was agreeable to the new schedule.
ex.zh: 她同意新的時間表。

aggrieved.zh: 感到委屈的、憤憤不平的

ex.en: The aggrieved customer asked to speak to the manager.
ex.zh: 那位感到委屈的顧客要求見經理。

ex.en: She felt aggrieved at being left out of the plan.
ex.zh: 她因為被排除在計畫之外而感到憤憤不平。

ex.en: The bad news agitated everyone in the office.
ex.zh: 這個壞消息讓辦公室裡的每個人都焦躁不安。

ex.en: Loud noises agitate the baby and make her cry.
ex.zh: 大的噪音讓寶寶不安而哭鬧。

ex.en: Workers agitated for better pay and shorter hours.
ex.zh: 工人們為爭取更高薪資和更短工時而發起行動。

ex.en: Agitate the bottle well before you pour the juice.
ex.zh: 倒果汁之前先把瓶子搖勻。

ex.en: The country has an agrarian economy based on rice and wheat.
ex.zh: 這個國家的經濟以稻米和小麥為主的農業為基礎。

ex.en: The government introduced agrarian reforms to help small farmers.
ex.zh: 政府推行土地改革來幫助小農。

ex.en: Life in the agrarian villages follows the rhythm of the seasons.
ex.zh: 農村的生活隨著季節的節奏運轉。

ex.en: The agonizing wait for the test results lasted three days.
ex.zh: 等待檢驗結果的煎熬持續了三天。

ex.en: He faced an agonizing choice between his job and his family.
ex.zh: 他面臨工作與家人之間令人痛苦的抉擇。

ex.en: He became agitated when the plane started to shake.
ex.zh: 飛機開始搖晃時，他變得焦躁不安。

ex.en: The agitated crowd waited outside the closed doors.
ex.zh: 激動的群眾在緊閉的大門外等待。

ex.en: The country was named as the aggressor in the conflict.
ex.zh: 該國被指為這場衝突中的侵略方。

ex.en: In the playground fight, it was hard to tell who was the aggressor.
ex.zh: 在操場上的打鬧中，很難分辨誰是挑釁的一方。

ex.en: The agile cat jumped onto the high shelf.
ex.zh: 那隻敏捷的貓跳上高高的架子。

ex.en: A good manager needs an agile mind.
ex.zh: 好主管需要靈活的頭腦。

ex.en: Cats are known for their agility.
ex.zh: 貓以敏捷聞名。

ex.en: The training improves speed and agility.
ex.zh: 這項訓練能提升速度與靈活度。

agonising.zh: 令人極度痛苦的；折磨人的

ex.en: The agonising wait for the test results lasted three days.
ex.zh: 等待檢查結果的煎熬持續了三天。

ex.en: He faced an agonising choice between his family and his career.
ex.zh: 他面臨家庭與事業之間痛苦的抉擇。

ex.en: The dog's aggressiveness worried the neighbors.
ex.zh: 那隻狗的攻擊性讓鄰居很擔心。

ex.en: Her aggressiveness in sales helped her win many clients.
ex.zh: 她在銷售上的積極進取讓她贏得了許多客戶。

ex.en: Don't agonize over every small decision.
ex.zh: 不要為每個小決定苦惱不已。

ex.en: She agonized for days about whether to quit her job.
ex.zh: 她為了要不要辭職煩惱了好幾天。

ex.en: Traffic jams are a daily aggravation for commuters.
ex.zh: 塞車是通勤者每天的煩惱。

ex.en: I don't need the aggravation of another argument today.
ex.zh: 我今天不想再為另一場爭吵惹來麻煩。

ex.en: The aggravation of his injury forced him to rest.
ex.zh: 他傷勢惡化，只好休息。

ex.en: Cold weather can cause an aggravation of the pain.
ex.zh: 天氣冷可能會使疼痛加劇。

ex.en: She stood aghast as the vase fell and broke.
ex.zh: 花瓶掉下來摔碎時，她嚇得呆站在原地。

ex.en: We were aghast at how much the repairs would cost.
ex.zh: 我們對修理費用之高感到震驚。

ex.en: He grew aggravated when the line didn't move.
ex.zh: 隊伍一直不動，他越來越惱火。

ex.en: The aggravated customer asked to speak to a manager.
ex.zh: 那位氣惱的顧客要求找經理談。

ex.en: The cold weather left her aggravated knee pain worse.
ex.zh: 寒冷的天氣讓她本已惡化的膝蓋痛更嚴重了。

ex.en: Doctors treated the aggravated injury right away.
ex.zh: 醫生立刻處理了這個惡化的傷勢。

aggravated.zh: 使惡化；激怒（aggravate 的過去式、過去分詞）

ex.en: Walking on it aggravated the ankle injury.
ex.zh: 走路使腳踝的傷勢惡化了。

ex.en: His constant noise aggravated the neighbors.
ex.zh: 他不斷製造噪音，惹惱了鄰居。

ex.en: Big agribusiness companies now control much of the food supply.
ex.zh: 大型農企業現在掌控了許多糧食供應。

ex.en: Her uncle works in agribusiness, selling farm equipment to growers.
ex.zh: 她叔叔在農企業工作，把農具賣給農民。
